scenarios.name: Hero Section Rendering
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and call-to-action buttons

steps.description: Access the root URL of the application
steps.context: User arrives at the site for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains a compelling headline, subheadline, and primary CTA
steps.context: Hero section should be full-width with BackgroundEffect component

steps.description: Check that primary CTA (Get Started/Register) and secondary CTA (Login) are present
steps.context: Buttons should use FuturisticButton component styling

test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline containing value proposition text
Hero section contains subheadline with supporting text
Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' or 'Create Free Account' is visible
Secondary CTA button for Login is visible
BackgroundEffect component is rendered in hero section

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays three key product features with icons and descriptions

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the landing page
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero

steps.description: Check that three feature cards are displayed using GlassMorphismCard component
steps.context: Features: URL Shortening, Analytics, Share Statistics

steps.description: Each feature card should have an icon, title, and description
steps.context: Grid layout: 3 columns on desktop, single column on mobile

test_cases.expected: Features section renders with exactly 3 feature cards
Feature card for 'Instant URL Shortening' is present with icon, title, and description
Feature card for 'Detailed Analytics' is present with icon, title, and description
Feature card for 'Share Statistics' is present with icon, title, and description
Feature cards use GlassMorphismCard component

scenarios.name: How It Works Section
scenarios.description: Verify the How It Works section displays the 3-step process (Create, Share, Track)

steps.action: Scroll to How It Works section
steps.description: Navigate to the How It Works section
steps.context: Section explains the 3-step URL shortening process

steps.description: Check that all three steps are displayed with proper labeling
steps.context: Steps: Create, Share, Track

test_cases.expected: How It Works section is present with section heading
Step 1 'Create' is displayed with description about pasting URL and getting short link
Step 2 'Share' is displayed with description about sharing shortened link
Step 3 'Track' is displayed with description about monitoring clicks and analytics
Steps are displayed in a visual flow format

steps.description: Click Login link and verify navigation to Login page
steps.context: Login link should redirect to /login

test_cases.input: Click primary CTA button on landing page
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to /register route

test_cases.input: Click Login button/link on landing page
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to /login route
Primary CTA has correct href or onClick handler for /register
Login link has correct href or onClick handler for /login
